name: FlowNest
objective: Increase qualified free-trial sign-ups from Egyptian SMBs

sources.title: Website — home page (EN)
sources.text:
# FlowNest — Team tasks, finally in one place
## About
FlowNest is a browser-based productivity platform that helps small and medium-sized businesses in Egypt organise team work.
Founded in Cairo in 2022.
## Mission
Make everyday team coordination simple for growing businesses.
## Features
- Shared team task boards
- Task assignments
- Reminders
- Browser-based dashboard
## Who it is for
- Small and medium-sized businesses in Egypt
- Operations and project leads who coordinate teams
## Why FlowNest
- One place for tasks, owners and deadlines
- Works in the browser with nothing to install
## Offer
14-day free trial
## Call to action
[Button] Start your free trial
[Button] Contact sales
## Channels
Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Email newsletter

sources.title: Website — الصفحة العربية
sources.text:
# فلو نست — مهام فريقك في مكان واحد
## المميزات
- لوحات مهام مشتركة للفريق
- توزيع المهام على أعضاء الفريق
- تذكيرات بالمواعيد
- لوحة تحكم تعمل من المتصفح
## لمن
- الشركات الصغيرة والمتوسطة في مصر
## العرض
تجربة مجانية لمدة 14 يوم
## الدعوة لاتخاذ إجراء
[زر] ابدأ تجربتك المجانية

sources.title: Company brochure 2024 (PDF text)
sources.text:
# FlowNest Company Brochure 2024
## Overview
FlowNest gives teams shared task boards with assignments and reminders.
## Offer
Try FlowNest with a 7-day free trial.
## Claims
- The #1 task management tool in Egypt
- Guaranteed to double your team's productivity
## Call to action
[Button] Request a demo

sources.title: Brand guidelines
sources.text:
# FlowNest Brand Guidelines
## Brand personality
- Clear, organised, encouraging
## Tone of voice
- Plain, friendly and practical. Avoid jargon and exaggerated promises.
## Messaging pillars
- Clarity: everyone knows who is doing what
- Momentum: reminders keep work moving
- Simplicity: open the browser and start
## Colors
Primary #1D4ED8, Secondary #4338CA, Ink #0F172A, Surface #FFFFFF, Accent #38BDF8
## Restrictions
- Do not quote customer numbers, rankings or guaranteed results
- Always state the trial length as 14 days

sources.title: Marketing plan 2026 (internal)
sources.text:
# FlowNest Marketing Plan 2026
## Business model
B2B SaaS subscription with a self-serve free trial.
## Customer acquisition
- Trial sign-ups from the website
- Enquiries through the contact form
- Referrals from existing customers
## Past campaigns
- "Back to work" September campaign on Facebook and Instagram
- How-to tips content series
## Differentiation
- Built for Egyptian SMB teams, with onboarding focused on simplicity

sources.title: Company CV & project portfolio 2026
sources.text:
# FlowNest Company CV
## Projects
- Team workspace rollout for a Cairo creative agency | Agencies | Shared team task boards | 2025 | Whole account team moved from chat threads to one board
- Campaign production tracking for a digital marketing agency | Agencies | Task assignments | 2026 | 
- Branch task coordination for a retail chain in Giza | Retail | Reminders | 2024 | Daily store checklists run from the dashboard
- Sprint board setup for a software studio in Alexandria | Software | Shared team task boards | 2025 | 
- Delivery follow-up board for a logistics operator | Logistics | Task assignments | 2023 | 
## Industries
- Marketing and creative agencies
- Retail
- Software and IT services
